kaikki_vikisozluk.e: اِحْتَضَنَ • (iḥtaḍana) VIII (non-past يَحْتَضِنُ (yaḥtaḍinu), verbal noun اِحْتِضَان (iḥtiḍān))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: The figurative meaning is a semantic loan from European languages like English embrace, French embrasser, Spanish abrazar, Portuguese abraçar, Italian abbracciare.
g: to take into arms, to embrace, to get to hold, to hug, to enfold
to embrace, to enshrine, to integrate
